facts.fact: AUDA-NEPAD reports that government, private-sector and civil-society representatives met in Moroni on 24-25 August 2026 at a workshop to review and validate the National Data Governance Strategy 2027-2031, whose implementation plan was also examined; it does not report approval or launch by the government.
facts.system: Stratégie nationale de gouvernance des données 2027-2031
